fields.summary: [Constants] Publish shared manual submission form contracts

content.text: User-approved first step of the submissions DRY/SOLID review: deliver shared manual submission form contracts in EnsuredConstants, open a PR, merge main, publish an updated registry package.

Acceptance: shared condition, field, object-property and template-section types; supported field/operator unions; framework-independent condition evaluator; root/subpath CJS, ESM and declaration exports; existing forms remain compatible. Add executable contract/condition/package-consumer verification and typecheck, ESLint and Prettier release gates. Bump package version, merge verified PR, publish matching tag, verify registry artifact.

Scope: additive Constants release first. API/UI source adoption, dashboard DTO consolidation, artifact-writer and seed-service refactors remain later work from the review, not completion claims for this ticket. AIN-177 is completed context, not a dependency. No new UI workflow, database migration or application deployment.
